scope: Administrator transaction search, journal detail, audit history, independent reconciliation and failed-work inspection

requirements.description: Server-authorized bounded transaction search with reference, kind, status, account/user, currency, amount and UTC time filters
Authoritative transaction detail with immutable journal entries and linked payment adjustments
Bounded redacted financial audit history, distinct from operational/security events
Independent read-only reconciliation in one consistent snapshot, with scope, timestamp and explicit discrepancy results
Administrator failed-work inspection using existing backend without a second replay implementation
Real responsive administrator browser journeys, keyboard and axe checks; customer/anonymous direct API denial
Preserve P01-P08E, execute named P08F tests and retain exact-source evidence without upgrading incomplete product status
